directive.quote: use it, and move the tool one to one under tools/.

old_copy.deleted_with: Old Worker retirement removed its source owners.

preserve: Validate channels, addresses, safe field paths, timing and state protocols, screen shapes and all word values.
Empty or withdrawn published sections remain empty, and a failed read cannot restore defaults.
allowed_deltas: Read independently addressed audience-send-content rows through the existing records door instead of the retired publication resolver; the engine admits the row resource and current rights.
Retain immutable protocol limits separately from row content.
banned_substitutions: A second store, hash owner, scheduler or provider sender.
Content defaults written into source files or a tool completion treated as delivery acknowledgement.
